arguments.content:
Gather close to the boiler-vents, little wrigglers. Feel that heat thrumming through the mud? That’s the heart of the Great Silt-Engine, churning away without a single overseer. You see those massive iron pistons and brass pressure-valves? We forged them in the deep clay, every bolt turned by a willing hand, every gear meshed by a shared purpose.

Long before your tails grew, the pond faced the Rust-Beetle Armada. They came with grinding mandibles and smoke-belching drills, aiming to strip our reed-forests bare. Did we wait for a crowned king to draw a battle line? Did we wait for a high council to vote on our survival? No. We are toads. We don't kneel.

When the sirens wailed, the pond moved as one living war-machine. The heavy-shelled turtles formed the vanguard, their shells clanking like tank treads. The nimble water-striders rigged the signal-flares on the high branches. And us? We manned the hydro-cannons and the steam-trebuchets. I was just a young polliwog like you, pumping the pressure valves until my fins blistered. I didn't do it because a general pointed a spear at my back. I did it because my clutch-mates were behind me, and the pond was our home.

We didn't need a boss to tell us who got the algae rations. We divided them by need. A heavy-lifter needs more fuel. A scout needs sharp eyes. We shared the spoils because a chain is only as strong as its weakest link, and we refuse to let any link rust.

Now look around. The frogs have their princes in the lily-pads, and the ants march to the drum of their queens. That is their path, and it keeps their hives strong. But our path is different. We are a brotherhood of free swimmers. When a dam cracks, we don't wait for permission to patch it. When a brother gets tangled in the weeds, we don't wait for a decree to cut him loose. We act. We build. We defend.

You are born into a society of equals, little ones. No crowns, no chains, just the unbreakable rhythm of mutual aid and the roar of our own engines. Keep your gills wide and your spirits fierce. You are toads. You build your own world, and you answer to no one but each other.
